use default

joined_larger_first(left: int, right: int) -> int =>
    string.compare_ordinal("{right}{left}", "{left}{right}")

largest(numbers: int[]) -> string =>
    numbers
        |> sort(joined_larger_first)
        |> map(number => "{number}")
        |> join("")

for numbers in [[1, 34, 3, 98, 9, 76, 45, 4], [54, 546, 548, 60]] do
    let listed = numbers |> map(number => "{number}") |> join(", ")

    write_line("{{{listed}}} gives {largest(numbers)}")
od
